error[ZBX-E1009]: the connection to the virtual machine was lost
  cause  the connection to the virtual machine ended: the guest hung up
  fix    see whether the machine runs:                             zbx vm status
         a container that was detached may still run; list them:   zbx ps
  more   zbx explain E1009 · rerun with --verbose for the full cause chain
  docs   https://zigbox.github.io/zigbox/errors/E1009.html
